retrieved.heading: 1. Annual Leave
retrieved.text: Confirmed full-time employees accrue 30 calendar days of annual leave per year, accruing at 2.5 days per completed month of service. results.question: What is the end-of-service gratuity for someone with a 12,000 AED basic salary and 7 years of service?
results.ground_truth: It is AED 66,000. The first five years earn 21 days each (105 days) and the two further years earn 30 days each (60 days), totalling 165 days; at a daily rate of AED 400 (12,000 / 30) that is 165 x 400 = AED 66,000.
results.answer:
The end-of-service gratuity for someone with a 12,000 AED basic salary and 7 years of service is AED 66,000.

Sources: 03_benefits_guide.md

retrieved.heading: 1. End-of-Service Gratuity
retrieved.text:
Gratuity is calculated on the last basic salary, per UAE law, for employees who complete at least one year of continuous service:
- For the first five years of service: 21 days of basic pay for each year of service.
- For each year beyond five years: 30 days of basic pay for each year.
**Worked example:** An employee with a basic salary of AED 12,000 and 7 years of service receives (5 × 21 days) + (2 × 30 days) = 105 + 60 = 165 days. Daily basic pay is 12,000 ÷ 30 = AED 400, so gratuity = 165 × 400 = **AED 66,000**. Total gratuity is capped at two years' total pay.

retrieved.heading: 7. Exit
retrieved.text: On resignation, confirmed employees give 30 days' notice unless the contract states otherwise. Final settlement, including any end-of-service gratuity calculated per UAE law, is paid within 14 days of the last working day. See the **Employee Benefits Guide** for gratuity calculation details.

results.question: Can I return opened cosmetics?

retrieved.heading: 2. Non-Returnable Items
retrieved.text: For hygiene and safety reasons, the following are non-returnable unless faulty: underwear, swimwear, pierced jewellery, opened cosmetics, perishable goods, and personalised or made-to-order items. Gift cards are non-refundable.

retrieved.text: Most items may be returned within 30 days of purchase with proof of purchase. Sale and clearance items may be returned within 14 days. The item must be unused, in its original packaging, and in resalable condition.

results.question: What annual spend do I need to reach Platinum loyalty tier, and what do I get?

retrieved.heading: 2. Membership Tiers
retrieved.text:
There are three tiers, reviewed every 12 months based on spend in the preceding year:
- **Silver:** the entry tier for all members. Standard earning.
- **Gold:** reached at AED 10,000 annual spend. Earns a 10% point bonus and early access to sales.

retrieved.text: Members earn 1 point for every AED 1 spent on eligible purchases. Own-brand Najmah products earn double points (2 points per AED 1). Points are credited within 48 hours of purchase. Purchases of gift cards do not earn points.

retrieved.heading: 3. Probation
retrieved.text: New employees serve a probation period of six months. During probation, either party may terminate employment with 14 days' written notice. Annual leave accrues during probation but may only be taken after confirmation, except in exceptional cases approved by a line manager.

retrieved.heading: 2. Sick Leave
retrieved.text: After probation, employees are entitled to up to 90 days of sick leave per year, paid as follows: the first 15 days at full pay, the next 30 days at half pay, and the remaining 45 days unpaid. A medical certificate is required for any absence longer than two consecutive days.

results.question: How quickly must a suspected data breach be reported and to whom?
results.ground_truth: A suspected data breach must be reported to the Data Protection Officer within 24 hours of discovery.
results.answer:
A suspected data breach must be reported within 24 hours of discovery to the Data Protection Officer.

Sources: 06_data_protection.md

retrieved.heading: 6. Security
retrieved.text: Personal data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Access is granted on a least-privilege basis. Staff handling personal data off-site must follow the remote-work safeguards in Handbook Section 5. Suspected data breaches must be reported to the Data Protection Officer within 24 hours of discovery.

retrieved.heading: 4. Data Subject Rights
retrieved.text: Customers and employees may request access to their data, correction of inaccurate data, or deletion where there is no overriding legal reason to retain it. Requests are answered within 30 days. Identity is verified before any data is released.

results.question: I returned an item I paid for with a loyalty discount. What happens to the points I earned and to my refund?
results.ground_truth: The points earned on that purchase are reversed/deducted when it is refunded (and if that would take the balance below zero, the balance is set to zero). The refund goes back to the original payment method, with card refunds appearing in 7 to 14 business days.
results.answer:
When you return an item, the loyalty points earned on that purchase are reversed or deducted. If the deduction would take your balance below zero, it is set to zero. 

Sources: 04_returns_policy.md, 05_loyalty_terms.md

retrieved.heading: 7. Loyalty Points on Returns
retrieved.text: Loyalty points earned on a purchase are reversed when that purchase is refunded. See the **Loyalty Programme Terms** for how points accrue and expire.

retrieved.heading: 5. Returns and Points
retrieved.text: When a purchase is refunded, the points earned on it are deducted. If the deduction would take the balance below zero, the balance is set to zero. See the **Customer Returns & Refunds Policy**.

retrieved.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Card refunds appear within 7 to 14 business days depending on the bank.
